headline: D P Wires submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: Procedural compliance update from D P Wires
summary: D P Wires Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The company also provided a copy of the meeting's minutes to the stock exchange. This is a routine regulatory filing required following shareholder meetings. The update carries no direct financial impact for retail investors.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate compliance with no immediate impact on stock price.

headline: D P Wires holds annual general meeting
summary: D P Wires Limited has submitted the official proceedings of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This is a routine compliance filing required for listed companies to document shareholder approvals and discussions. Retail investors should note this is standard procedure with no direct impact on immediate stock performance.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate compliance with no immediate impact.
